verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Phaser is distributed as a single npm package and CDN script, plus a CLI that offers official project templates and demo games. It also ships editor tools such as pixel-art, tilemap and atlas editors and SFX generation, and an examples index. None of this documents an asset store, plugin marketplace, or third-party package ecosystem offering ready-made models, tools, or plugins. Starter templates, examples and built-in editor features are adjacent capabilities rather than the ecosystem the story asks for.
